title: Marketing Analytics query errors must surface the query ID (error ID first, never previous response)
answers: Marketing analytics error doesn't show query ID
How do I add a query ID to a failed marketing analytics query error?
Which query ID should an error banner display: response or error object?
body:
Every Marketing Analytics surface that renders a query failure passes a query ID derived from the dataNodeLogic as `responseErrorObject?.queryId ?? queryId`.
- The error object's ID wins over the current request `queryId`.
- Never fall back to `response.query_status.id`: a previous successful response must not supply the ID (asserted in NewMarketingAnalyticsDashboard.test.tsx).
- Applied in: products/marketing_analytics/frontend/dashboard/NewMarketingAnalyticsDashboard.tsx (traffic and customers use separate logics and separate IDs), frontend/src/scenes/web-analytics/tabs/marketing-analytics/frontend/components/AttributionTab/AttributionTable.tsx, AttributionTab/ConversionPaths.tsx, MarketingAnalyticsOverview/MarketingAnalyticsOverview.tsx, and products/marketing_analytics/frontend/retention/RetentionResults.tsx.
- A new query surface must destructure `responseErrorObject, queryId` from useValues(logic) and pass the result to `InsightErrorState queryId=` or `MarketingQueryError queryId=`.
applies: Any Marketing Analytics component that renders a dataNodeLogic error state.
